source.title: HCD, Senate Bill 79 advisory for metropolitan planning organizations
source.quote: will take effect on July 1, 2026, in Alameda, Los Angeles, Sacramento, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, and San Diego Counties

statute: Gov. Code § 65912.156(q) defines an urban transit county by its count of passenger rail stations and lists no counties.

openIssue.summary: ABAG's SB 79 summary counts Orange County as an eighth urban transit county, citing legislative analysis; HCD's advisory does not list it.
